name: Omagram
author: ReidenXerx
description: An unofficial Telegram client that lives in your Omarchy desktop: reply from the bar with voice, round video or stickers, know who wrote by a sound of their own, act on notifications. Keyboard-first, in your theme. Built on TDLib; not affiliated with Telegram.

barWidget.description: Unread dot and the quick view: reply, record and listen from the bar (unofficial Telegram client)
